description.html: Sera Reptil Professional Herbivor Nature is a complementary food for herbivorous reptiles such as tortoises and iguanas. The two-colored granules have an outer ring with fiber-rich herbs and smaller amounts of protein and fat, while the core is produced at a lower temperature to preserve nutrients. It is part of the Sera Nature range, with no artificial dyes or preservatives.

Ingredients include stinging nettle, alfalfa, parsley, spinach, paprika, carrots, spirulina (6%) and sea algae, with small amounts of gammarus and green-lipped mussel. Vitamins A, D3, E, B1, B2 and C are added.

Feed daily but sparingly, as a snack between main meals or mixed with fresh food such as romaine lettuce, dandelion and stinging nettle. The granules can be given dry or moistened with water. Fresh greens and herbs should still make up most of a herbivore's diet. Learn more about the setup in our tortoise terrarium guide.

Order by phone or WhatsApp message. Fast courier delivery. Customers in Novi Sad can pick up their order directly at our workshop. Contact us with any questions about the product or for a recommendation for your species.
